TestNativeTransportSSL::test_connect_to_.description: Single node with client_encryption_options enabled on the default CQL port 9042. Asserts a non-SSL driver connection fails (NoHostAvailable) and the server logs a TLS handshake error ('An unexpected TLS packet was received' / 'session has been invalidated'), then an SSL client (no server-cert verification) connects and does putget. Guards that enabling client encryption actually encrypts the plain native port.

TestNativeTransportSSL::test_connect_to_.description: Single node, client encryption with truststore, require_client_auth=True and certficate_revocation_list (scylla's own misspelled option name, db/config.cc:2288). Asserts a non-SSL client fails + TLS error logged, a client with cert connects and does putget; then revokes the cert at runtime (openssl ca -revoke/-gencrl), waits for 'cql_server ... Reloaded ccm_node.crl' and asserts the same cert can no longer connect. Guards CRL support (scylla#9630) and live CRL reload.

TestNativeTransportSSL::test_reload_cert.description: Single node with client encryption on 9042. Generates new certs in tmp_path, asserts a client trusting only the new CA fails to connect (server still serves old cert), copies new cert/key over the old files, waits for 'cql_server ... Reloaded ccm_node.pem/ccm_node.key' and connects with SSL + putget. Guards live TLS certificate reload for CQL (scylla PR #6152).

TestServerEncryption::test_server_encryp.description: 2-node cluster with server_encryption_options internode_encryption=all (no client auth). putget, then stop/start node1 twice and putget again. Reproducer for scylladb#14299: segfault on boot (null TLS credentials) when failure detector sent to TLS endpoints before messaging_service start_listen; fixed by e1a52af69e 'messaging_service: Do TLS init early'.
